interview.name: Bo
interview.answer: The repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center.

reflections: Rosa and Bo coordinate through practical neighborhood repair efforts and keep each other informed about needs.
Bo responds supportively and is willing to pass along information, suggesting a cooperative relationship.
Rosa’s follow-up shows she is distracted but still engaged and looking for concrete ways to help.
Bo is coordinating the repair drive and keeping the list of needed fixes focused on concrete issues like steps, taps, and lights.
Rosa is leading the organizing effort but was briefly distracted, while the others are responding supportively and offering practical help.
Dane and Gus show strong willingness to contribute, with Dane especially moving from general help to supplying materials and checking repairs.
Bo is coordinating the repair drive and keeping communication practical, especially around timing and low-key participation.
Dane is willing to contribute hands-on help and supplies, suggesting reliable follow-through on concrete tasks.
Tess tends to smooth coordination by relaying logistics and helping others fit into the event flow.
Bo is the main coordinator and keeps people updated on the repair drive plan, especially logistics and follow-through.
Hana and others want clear timing and supply details before they can participate effectively.
The group is supportive and practical, with multiple people offering help around scheduling, supplies, and outreach.
Bo is coordinating a community repair drive and actively routing volunteers and reports to the right organizers.
Sam and Pia are helping with logistics and supplies, showing a shared, practical coordination role.
The group is focused on clear event details and follow-through, with timing, location, and needed materials still being finalized.

events.text: Rosa: I’m putting together the repair drive list now, Bo—if you know anyone with a broken step, leaky tap, or busted light, send them my way.
events.speaker: Rosa

events.text: Bo: Sure thing, Rosa — I’ll keep an eye out and send folks your way if I hear of any busted steps, leaks, or lights.
events.speaker: Bo

events.text: Rosa: Oh right, the repair drive—sorry, I was just thinking about something else. What do you need me to bring or fix?
events.speaker: Rosa

events.text: Bo: Yep, I’ll keep an eye out and send anyone your way if I hear about busted steps, leaks, or lights.
events.speaker: Bo

events.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Bo: Sounds good, Gus — appreciate it.
events.speaker: Bo

events.text: Dane: I’m late, but I can help too—what still needs fixing, and do you need any supplies picked up?
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Bo: Thanks, Dane — I think we still need folks with broken steps, leaky taps, or busted lights. If you can grab a few basic supplies, that’d be a huge help.
events.speaker: Bo

events.text: Dane: I can pick up basic supplies and check on the broken steps, leaky taps, and busted lights. Send me the list of what you’re short on.
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Tess: Oh, that’s great—if you’re still heading over, I’d go early so you can catch the organizers before it gets busy. Folks are already bringing in tools, paint, and snacks, so it’s shaping up nicely.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Bo: I can help a little, but I need to keep it low-key today. If school pickup timing helps, I can work around that.
events.speaker: Bo

events.text: Tess: Oh, that’s really helpful, Bo—school pickup timing sounds like a smart way to keep it easy. I’ll let the organizers know you can work around that, and they can slot you in low-key.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Hana: I’m still waiting on the start time and whether I need to bring anything specific for the repair drive.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m still waiting on the start time too. If I hear back, I’ll let you know what to bring.
events.speaker: Bo

events.text: Hana: Thanks, Bo — please let me know as soon as you hear back on the start time and what I should bring.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Bo: Thanks, Sam — that sounds helpful. I’ll keep repeating the repair drive plan and let folks know what’s still needed.
events.speaker: Bo

events.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup times if that makes the repair drive easier. What do you need from me?
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Bo: Thanks, Faye — if you can help line up folks around pickup, that’d be great. I’m still gathering names for broken steps, leaky taps, and busted lights.
events.speaker: Bo

events.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can check what supplies we already have and note anything we still need for the repair drive.
events.speaker: Sam

events.text: Bo: Thanks, Sam — just keep me posted on what we still need. I’ll send anyone I hear about your way.
events.speaker: Bo

events.text: Sam: Thanks, Vik — I’ll catch up with everyone and help however I can. Just let me know if there’s anything specific you still need for the repair drive.
events.speaker: Sam

events.text: Pia: Thanks, Bo — the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center. I’m just making sure we’ve got the logistics straight.
events.speaker: Pia

prov.value: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.

events.text: Bo: Got it — Sunday at the community center. Do you want me to bring anything, or are we set?
events.speaker: Bo

events.text: Pia: If you can, please bring the sign-in sheet and a few pens. I’m checking that we’ve got everything covered for Sunday.
events.speaker: Pia

prov.value: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.

events.text: Bo: I’ll keep an eye out and send folks your way if I hear about a broken step, leaky tap, or busted light.
events.speaker: Bo

events.text: Leo: Thanks, Bo — that helps. Please send them to the community center on Sunday; I’m still checking the start time and supplies.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll send folks to the community center on Sunday. Let me know the start time and any supplies they should bring.
